postTitle: Will there be more holiday versions of FNAF 4?
postSubject: It would be cool to see the Thanksgiving, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Easter, St. Patrick's Day and Fourth of July versions of FNAF 4. Maybe in one of the versions (likely Christmas), We can see the nightmare toy animatronics!
commentSubject: I think that might get out of hand. Besides, a Thanksgiving version of FNaF doesn't have quite the same appeal as a Halloween version. ;)
